# reveal ## Overview Reveal.js is a robust HTML presentation framework that enables the creation of professional, interactive slide decks using standard web technologies. It is particularly useful for developers and technical presenters who prefer version-controlling their content, using Markdown for slide authoring, or integrating live code and data visualizations directly into their presentations.
